title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.

AI.tldr: SwarmEvolve框架通过让数百个低成本代理在潜在空间中推理和通信，实现快速、低成本的程序搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM引导的进化搜索因生成冗长文本思维链及重复生成以维持种群多样性而导致速度缓慢。
AI.method: 提出SwarmEvolve框架，代理在潜在空间中推理并通过传递KV缓存共享信息；使用新颖性过滤器基于隐藏状态向量距离保留独特想法；通过汇总器代理组合群体成员的KV缓存实现潜在空间中的想法交叉。
AI.result: 在21个数学和科学计算问题上，SwarmEvolve获得最高平均分，仅需3至8分钟即达到其他SOTA框架需60分钟才能达到的最佳分数；在部分问题上，使用Qwen3 8B的SwarmEvolve超越了AlphaEvolve最初用前沿LLM找到的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 在潜在空间中通信的代理群体为科学问题的程序搜索提供了一种快速且低成本的有效方法。

title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
summary: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. This migration is (1) a practical need, since it unlocks different hardware for researchers, and (2) a natural benchmark: it involves different frameworks and hardware, covers whole repositories, and is long-horizon and challenging. We introduce XStack, a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories between these two ecosystems. Each agent receives a PyTorch repository and a clean TPU machine and must deliver a JAX repository. Its output passes if it meets our grading criteria, based on the source repository's published result, authenticated and calibrated by us. Migration by agents remains unreliable: Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%, and every other agent at most 40%. XStack is a step toward freeing ML code from its ecosystem. We release XStack to make progress toward reliable migration across frameworks and hardware measurable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了XStack基准，用于评估智能体在PyTorch和JAX生态系统间迁移机器学习代码库的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前机器学习代码受限于特定框架和硬件，跨生态系统迁移既是解锁不同硬件的实际需求，也是一个涉及不同框架、硬件及整个代码库的具有挑战性的自然基准。
AI.method: 提出XStack基准测试，要求智能体接收PyTorch代码库和干净的TPU机器，并输出JAX代码库，其结果根据源代码库已发表结果设定的评分标准进行校准。
AI.result: 智能体进行代码迁移仍不可靠，其中Claude Opus 5通过率为75%，GPT-5.6-sol为45%，其他所有智能体至多为40%。
AI.conclusion: XStack是使机器学习代码摆脱生态系统束缚的重要一步，通过发布该基准，可衡量跨框架和硬件进行可靠迁移的进展。

title: Cognitive Tours: Making Understanding a Deliverable in AI-Assisted Development
summary: Generative AI and agentic coding are accelerating software development, leading to concerns about technical debt. But two less visible forms of debt, cognitive debt and intent debt, are emerging as key risks to software health. Cognitive debt is the absence or erosion of a team's shared understanding where no one can confidently explain how a system works or predict the impact of a change. Intent debt is the lack of clearly articulated goals, constraints, and rationale that explain what the system is for and guide how it should evolve. This paper presents Cognitive Tours, a tool designed to mitigate and repair cognitive and intent debt. Cognitive Tours is a web-based prototype for creating and following curated paths connecting user needs, design decisions, code, tests, and open questions. AI-assisted skills help audit existing waypoints and tours for possible problems or staleness and suggest candidates for new ones; humans decide what matters, verify relationships, and construct the narrative. This division of work deliberately preserves productive friction: the sensemaking involved in selecting, explaining, and revising a tour, which is intended to foster and share understanding. Our demonstration uses a tour of Cognitive Tours itself to introduce the tool and illustrate its design decisions and interaction mechanisms. A proposed evaluation agenda concludes the paper. A demo is available at https://cognitive-tours-demo.vercel.app/
comment: 6 pages, shorter version submitted to ICSE 2027 Demo Track (under review)

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Cognitive Tours的Web工具，通过人机协作创建连接需求和代码的导览路径，以缓解生成式AI开发带来的认知债务和意图债务。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI和代理编码加速了软件开发，导致团队缺乏对系统工作原理共享理解的“认知债务”以及缺乏明确系统目标与原理的“意图债务”，这两种隐性债务正成为软件健康的关键风险。
AI.method: 提出Cognitive Tours工具，通过构建连接用户需求、设计决策、代码、测试和开放问题的策展路径来修复债务。AI负责审计现有路径的问题和过时情况并提出新候选，人类负责验证关系和构建叙事，以保留促进理解的生产性摩擦。
AI.result: 通过使用Cognitive Tours自身的导览作为演示，展示了工具的设计决策和交互机制，并在文末提出了未来的评估议程。
AI.conclusion: Cognitive Tours通过人机分工有效保留了知识构建过程中的生产性摩擦，有助于修复认知和意图债务，未来需进一步开展评估工作。

title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
summary: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide, and introduce ReproBridge, an agent workflow for constructing these refined reproducible artifacts. ReproBridge-Bench provides 1,029 tasks from 387 experiments across 36 papers, anchored by five human-verified reference scores per task. Agents attempt tasks in fresh sessions with raw code or refined artifacts; a separate Auditor checks execution evidence. Across four evaluated models, refined artifacts raise mean reproduction success from 76.4% to 92.6% and reduce downstream API spending by 19.7% on average. The cross-model success-rate spread narrows from 21.6 to 3.9 percentage points, with all four models achieving mean success rates above 90%. Removing any component reduces success in the ablation study, with the largest losses from code and environment removal. These results suggest that preserving execution knowledge helps even models with lower raw-code success reproduce experiments more reliably and at lower API cost.

AI.tldr: 提出ReproBridge工作流及基准测试，通过构建保留执行知识的精炼工件，显著提升了机器学习实验的独立复现成功率并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 机器学习实验复现困难，因为相关流程散落在论文、代码和辅助工件中，导致编码智能体复现成功与否取决于其填补缺失细节的能力，而非仅依赖已发布的工件。
AI.method: 定义了包含精炼代码库、环境设置、实验启动器和复现指南的标准化工件设计，并提出构建这些工件的智能体工作流ReproBridge。此外，引入了包含1,029个任务的ReproBridge-Bench基准，评估智能体使用原始代码或精炼工件执行任务的表现，并由审计员检查执行证据。
AI.result: 精炼工件将平均复现成功率从76.4%提升至92.6%，并将API支出平均降低19.7%。模型间的成功率差距从21.6个百分点缩小至3.9个百分点，所有四个模型的平均成功率均超过90%。消融实验表明，移除任何组件都会降低成功率，其中代码和环境的移除造成的影响最大。
AI.conclusion: 保留执行知识有助于即使是原始代码成功率较低的模型也能更可靠、以更低的API成本复现实验。

title: The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI
summary: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“元访问”概念，赋予AI助手对界面本身的结构化、权限化视图，使其成为控制整个工作空间的控制层。
AI.motivation: 传统的LLM聊天界面仅能看到当前对话内容，无法感知和操作周围的整个工作空间环境。
AI.method: 提出一种包含功能辅导、元数据访问、信息检索、确认变更及全面编排的多层级“元访问”架构，并在“Meta Chat”原型中实现了有界上下文构建、引用链接和确认可逆更改等功能。
AI.result: Meta Chat原型验证了该方法，将聊天客户端转变为统一的查找、导航、组织和操作入口，但也指出了在接地、隐私、提示注入和信任方面的潜在风险。
AI.conclusion: AI时代的界面应暴露其状态和能力的结构化、权限化模型（如通过调试器接口），从而在不牺牲用户控制权的前提下将聊天扩展为代理能力的控制层。

title: Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks
summary:
Coding agents are among the most economically consequential deployments of LLMs to date, making reliable evaluation increasingly important. Yet even benchmarks that are carefully validated at release can become stale. As models improve, they can discover valid solutions that existing verifiers reject, while changes to evaluation infrastructure can invalidate assumptions embedded in tasks and tests. We call the resulting accumulation of defects benchmark maintenance debt: a growing gap between benchmark scores and the capabilities they are intended to measure. We introduce a continuous-validation workflow for agentic benchmarks that combines community reports, task artifacts, agent traces, automated oracle checks, and human-gated repairs. We apply this workflow to Terminal-Bench 2.0, a benchmark that underwent extensive human and LM-assisted review and red-teaming before release. Our audit identifies issues in roughly 30% of the benchmark, and we release the resulting repairs as Terminal-Bench 2.1. These repairs change evaluation results: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points and leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks, even as the overall ranking remains highly correlated (Spearman rho = 0.958).
  We evaluate how resource allocation shapes benchmark conclusions. We show that fixed wall-clock can materially change agent performance: For example, extending the time limit closes a 20pp harness gap on GPT 5.4 and shrinks a 30 pp gap on GPT 5.4 mini to 5 pp. Benchmark maintenance is therefore not only about repairing task artifacts: resource budgets are part of the measurement specification and must be validated alongside the tasks themselves.
  More broadly, benchmark maintenance debt is not just accumulated implementation bugs: our results show that as models improve, both evaluation assumptions and resource settings may need to be revalidated.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基准维护债务概念，并引入持续验证工作流修复了Terminal-Bench 2.0约30%的问题，同时证明资源预算是测量规范的重要组成部分。
AI.motivation: 随着模型改进和评估基础设施的变化，经过验证的基准测试也会过时，导致基准分数与实际能力之间出现差距，因此需要可靠的评估方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 引入结合社区报告、任务工件、代理轨迹、自动预言机检查和人工门控修复的持续验证工作流，并应用于Terminal-Bench 2.0基准测试，同时评估资源分配（如挂钟时间）对结论的影响。
AI.result: 审计发现Terminal-Bench 2.0约30%存在问题，修复后准确率提高10个百分点以上，排行榜位置最多变动三名（总体排名高度相关）。此外，延长时限显著缩小了不同模型间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 基准维护债务不仅是实现错误的累积，随着模型的进步，评估假设和资源设置均需重新验证。

title: Social Humanoid: Socially Responsive Human-Humanoid Interaction
summary: Humanoid robots are typically trained as solitary agents, leaving them unable to coordinate physically with human partners who naturally anticipate and adjust to one another. To bridge this gap, we present Social Humanoid, a hierarchical system that generates and executes socially responsive whole-body motion on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 conditioned on a human partner's motion. Its high-level policy performs flexible sequence modeling of human and humanoid motion through a shared tokenized representation, generating reactive humanoid motion and anticipating the partner's motion when they are occluded, while a low-level whole-body tracking controller executes the generated motion on the robot. To train the system, we introduce a two-phase adaptive retargeting procedure that retargets one interaction partner to the robot while morphing the other partner to preserve contact dynamics, reachability, and relative body scale. We apply this procedure across five motion-capture datasets to produce a new Human-Humanoid Interaction (HHI) benchmark of 260 hours of human-humanoid interactions. Our results demonstrate that Social Humanoid produces coordinated, human-aligned behavior across diverse interaction types in simulation and the real world. Project page: https://von31.github.io/social-humanoid/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层系统Social Humanoid，使人形机器人能够根据人类伙伴的运动生成并执行具有社交响应性的全身协调动作。
AI.motivation: 现有人形机器人通常作为孤立智能体训练，缺乏与人类伙伴进行自然物理协调、预期和适应的能力。
AI.method: 构建包含高层策略和低层全身跟踪控制器的分层系统。高层策略利用共享令牌化表示进行序列建模，生成反应性动作并预期被遮挡伙伴的运动。同时引入两阶段自适应重定向程序以保留接触动力学和相对身体比例，并生成了260小时的人-机器人交互（HHI）基准数据集。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，Social Humanoid在多种交互类型下均表现出协调且符合人类行为特征的动作。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成功实现了人形机器人与人类的物理协调交互，并提供了大规模的HHI交互基准，为未来人机协作研究奠定了基础。

title: SCALE: Real-Time Latent Communication for Cyber-Physical Agents
summary: Latent communication enables agents to collaborate efficiently by directly exchanging intermediate model representations rather than raw sensor data or text messages. Existing approaches, however, are primarily designed for LLM agents and do not consider the bandwidth constraints and heterogeneous task deadlines faced by cyber-physical agents. In this work, we propose SCALE, a real-time latent communication method tailored for cyber-physical agents. Motivated by the spatio-temporal continuity of the physical world, SCALE matches tokens across consecutive latent messages using similarity scores to identify reusable information and avoid redundant transmission. It then profiles the semantic gain and communication cost of transmitting different amounts of latent information. Based on these profiles, SCALE employs a real-time scheduler that jointly determines which pending messages to transmit and how many latent tokens to send, subject to available bandwidth and task deadlines. We evaluate SCALE across three cyber-physical benchmarks and a physical spider robot case study under diverse network conditions and heterogeneous task deadlines. Our results show that SCALE significantly improves both task performance and on-time delivery in bandwidth-constrained networks. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCALE-4E80/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SCALE，一种针对信息物理智能体的实时潜在通信方法，旨在解决带宽限制和异构任务截止期限下的通信效率问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的潜在通信方法主要针对大语言模型智能体设计，未考虑信息物理智能体所面临的带宽限制和异构任务截止期限问题。
AI.method: SCALE利用物理世界的时空连续性，通过相似度评分匹配连续潜在消息中的token以识别可重用信息并避免冗余传输；分析传输不同数量潜在信息的语义增益与通信成本；并采用实时调度器，在带宽和任务截止期限约束下联合决定传输哪些消息及发送多少token。
AI.result: 在三个信息物理基准测试和一个物理蜘蛛机器人案例研究中的评估表明，在带宽受限的网络环境下，SCALE显著提升了任务性能和按时交付率。
AI.conclusion: SCALE有效解决了信息物理智能体在带宽受限和异构截止期限下的实时通信挑战，验证了利用时空连续性优化潜在通信的有效性。

title: Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
summary: Different optimizers impose different geometries on parameter updates. Adaptive methods such as Adam and AdamW use coordinate-wise updates, while matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon utilize weight-matrix structure through orthogonalized updates. For Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), however, the effective geometry of its weight matrices is shaped not only by its learned channel-mixing weights, but also by the graph-propagated representations it acts on. Thus, even if an update is well normalized as a matrix, its effect on the layer output can be amplified when applied to graph-propagated features. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMuon, a graph-aware optimizer that adapts Muon's matrix updates to the covariance structure of graph-propagated layer inputs. GraphMuon performs orthogonalization in a metric defined by these propagated representations and normalizes step sizes according to the update's induced effect on the layer representation. We show that theoretically, vanilla Muon can suffer from graph-induced update amplification, while our GraphMuon can mitigate this effect. As such, our GraphMuon yields a graph-metric analogue of Muon's polar update step. Empirically, GraphMuon achieves $1.32\times$-$2.42\times$ validation-loss time-to-target speedups over AdamW on three large-scale OGB benchmarks. Across 15 dataset-architecture configurations spanning node classification, inductive graph classification, and graph regression, it achieves lower time-to-target in 13 cases, while maintaining competitive or superior predictive performance. Code is available at https://github.com/guy-hadad/GraphMuon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图感知优化器GraphMuon，通过适应图传播特征的协方差结构来改进Muon优化器，在GNN任务中实现了显著的加速和性能提升。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络（GNN）中图传播特征会导致权重更新效果被放大，而现有的矩阵感知优化器（如Muon）未考虑此问题，无法有效适应GNN的几何结构。
AI.method: 提出GraphMuon优化器，在由图传播层输入定义的度量空间中进行正交化，并根据更新对层表示的诱导效果来标准化步长。
AI.result: 理论证明GraphMuon可缓解图诱导的更新放大效应；在三个OGB基准上比AdamW快1.32x-2.42x；在15种配置中13种达到更短的时间目标，且预测性能具有竞争力或更优。
AI.conclusion: GraphMuon成功将矩阵感知优化与GNN几何特性结合，解决了图传播导致的更新放大问题，为大规模GNN训练提供了更高效的方案。

title: Information Elicitation by Ordinal Agreement
summary: Ordinal information is central to tasks ranging from conference peer review to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback for large language models. In many such settings, there is no objective ground truth against which reports can be directly verified, making incentive-compatible elicitation challenging. Peer-prediction mechanisms have been designed to achieve truthful elicitation despite the lack of ground-truth verification. However, existing peer-prediction methods do not provide incentives for agents to truthfully compress rich private information (e.g. reviews) into coarser ordinal reports (e.g. rankings) requested by the mechanisms. We propose a simple ordinal peer-prediction mechanism that rewards agents based on pairwise agreement, measured by Kendall tau. Under a broad class of Bayesian Stochastically Order Consistent models---which includes classical models such as Mallows and Thurstone---we prove that truthful reporting is stochastically dominant, and strongly truthful under index-equivariant strategies. This provides robust incentives even for agents with non-linear utility functions, such as risk aversion. Our mechanism further accommodates heterogeneous agents, top-K reports, and subset assignments, where each agent is scored against one randomly drawn peer. Experiments on synthetic Mallows and Thurstone data, together with a real-data stress test on the SUSHI preference dataset, show right-shifted truthful-payment distributions and the highest normalized sensitivity among tested baselines.
comment: 33 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the 22nd Conference on Web and Internet Economics (WINE 2026)

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Kendall tau成对一致性的序数同侪预测机制，在缺乏基准真值时激励智能体如实压缩并报告其私有信息。
AI.motivation: 在会议同行评审和大模型RLHF等缺乏客观基准真值的场景中，现有同侪预测方法未能有效激励智能体将丰富的私有信息如实压缩为较粗糙的序数报告。
AI.method: 提出一种通过Kendall tau度量的成对一致性来奖励智能体的序数同侪预测机制。在贝叶斯随机序一致性模型下，证明如实报告是随机占优的，且在指标等变策略下是强真实的。该机制支持异构智能体、Top-K报告和子集分配，并对风险规避等非线性效用提供稳健激励。
AI.result: 在合成Mallows和Thurstone数据及SUSHI真实数据集上的实验显示，该机制的真实支付分布右移，且在测试基线中具有最高的归一化敏感度。
AI.conclusion: 提出的机制在无基准真值的情况下为序数报告提供了稳健且强真实的激励兼容性，并能适应异构智能体和Top-K报告等复杂实际场景。

title: PBPO: Prefix-Block Policy Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) commonly decode responses by proceeding autoregressively across blocks while iteratively denoising multiple tokens within each block. This structure makes block-level policy optimization a natural adaptation of autoregressive policy optimization. However, the exact likelihood of a completed block is intractable because it marginalizes over the intermediate states and reveal orders of the denoising process. To realize the block-level formulation, we construct a prefix-block state and use a single model evaluation to define a factorized one-step surrogate for the block likelihood. The resulting block surrogate ratio is a product of its token surrogate ratios, allowing variation at individual positions to propagate across the entire block before clipping. We therefore introduce Prefix-Block Policy Optimization (PBPO), which preserves block-level conditioning but applies surrogate importance weighting and clipping separately to each token. PBPO further diversifies repeated updates by resampling corrupted views of the prompt and revealed prefix, a design motivated by masked-dLLM pre-training. Under our analysis assumptions, block-product weighting amplifies the variance of gradient contributions relative to token-local weighting. Across two LLaDA-family initializations, six benchmarks, and three generation lengths, PBPO achieves competitive performance against existing dLLM RL methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Prefix-Block Policy Optimization (PBPO)，一种针对扩散大语言模型(dLLMs)的块级策略优化方法，通过分离token级别的代理重要性加权和裁剪来保留块级条件信息。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过自回归地处理块并在每个块内迭代去噪多个token来解码响应，使得块级策略优化成为自然选择。然而，完整块的精确似然是不可处理的，因为它需要对去噪过程的中间状态和揭示顺序进行边缘化。这造成了一个核心问题：如何在保留块级条件的同时实现有效的策略优化。
AI.method: 论文构建了前缀块状态，使用单次模型评估定义块似然的因子化单步代理。块代理比率是token代理比率的乘积，允许在裁剪前将单个位置的变化传播到整个块。PBPO保留块级条件，但将代理重要性加权和裁剪分别应用于每个token。此外，PBPO通过对提示和已揭示前缀的损坏视图进行重采样来多样化重复更新，这一设计受掩码dLLM预训练启发。
AI.result: 在两个LLaDA系列初始化、六个基准测试和三个生成长度上，PBPO相对于现有dLLM强化学习方法取得了有竞争力的性能。理论分析表明，块乘积加权相对于token局部加权会放大梯度贡献的方差。
AI.conclusion: PBPO成功解决了dLLM中块级策略优化的似然不可处理问题，在保持块级条件的同时实现了有效的token级别优化。该方法为扩散语言模型的强化学习提供了一条可行的技术路径。

title: VIGOR: Visual Gain Ordering for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种免训练的即插即用推理策略VIGOR，通过反事实视觉证据重新排序掩码位置，以解决多模态离散扩散语言模型中的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态离散扩散语言模型存在幻觉问题，其根源在于迭代去噪时的“过早承诺”现象：部分位置受语言先验影响而过早解掩码，从而误导后续生成。
AI.method: 提出视觉增益排序（VIGOR）策略，通过比较原始图像条件与视觉消融条件下的候选token置信度，优先处理视觉证据支持更强的位置，从而重新排序去噪过程中的掩码位置。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-V和Lumina-DiMOO模型上的实验表明，VIGOR持续降低了幻觉现象，并在多个基准测试中提升了多模态推理性能。
AI.conclusion: VIGOR通过基于视觉证据的推理重排序，有效缓解了多模态dLLMs的幻觉与过早承诺问题，提升了模型的多模态推理能力。

title: Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. To this end, we design Step-dLLM, which periodically refreshes a block-sparse mask at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and reuses it within each locally consistent interval, while employing a head-adaptive global budget that more aggressively compresses heads with concentrated attention. Backed by a fused IO-aware Triton kernel for block-sparse attention, Step-dLLM applies to pre-trained LLaDA-1.5 and Dream-7B-Instruct without retraining, achieving a 2.78x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention on LLaDA-1.5 at 8K context with 256 denoising steps and 90% sparsity, while improving the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior sparse-attention methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Step-dLLM，一种无需重训练的块稀疏注意力方法，通过周期性刷新掩码和头自适应预算，显著加速扩散大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型因双向注意力无法使用KV缓存，导致每步二次方计算开销。现有稀疏方法复用固定掩码且均匀分配预算，忽略了注意力模式跨步的局部一致性与突变性，以及不同注意力头集中度的差异。
AI.method: 设计Step-dLLM：在锚点步骤周期性刷新块稀疏掩码并在局部一致区间复用；采用头自适应全局预算更激进地压缩注意力集中的头；结合融合的IO感知Triton内核实现。
AI.result: 无需重训练应用于LLaDA-1.5和Dream-7B-Instruct。在LLaDA-1.5上（8K上下文、256步去噪、90%稀疏度）实现端到端2.78倍加速（对比密集FlashAttention），并在精度-延迟权衡上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: Step-dLLM通过利用dLLM注意力的结构特性有效解决推理效率瓶颈，为无重训练的高效部署提供了新途径。

title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE与dLLM-KVQ方法，解决扩散语言模型中KV缓存重用误差下的量化问题，并在多种任务中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存量化方法主要针对自回归模型，而扩散语言模型在跨去噪步骤重用KV缓存时，双向token表示会随掩码揭示而变化，产生缓存重用误差，使得直接量化面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出TRACE重建符合迭代掩码解码的dLLM揭示轨迹以提供校准状态；提出dLLM-KVQ利用该轨迹，根据输出和注意力行为指标选择性地将部分K缓存条目保持高精度，同时对其他部分应用低比特量化。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型及GSM8K等四个数据集上的实验表明，dLLM-KVQ在4-bit和2-bit前缀/双缓存设置下的所有量化方法中取得了最高平均分。
AI.conclusion: 考虑缓存重用误差的量化策略能显著提升扩散语言模型在低比特配置下的性能，为高效dLLM推理提供了有效解决方案。

title: DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine
summary: Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific information absent from the prompt and require no additional model execution. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on five models from three dLLM families under bursty workloads, DWISE reduces mean end-to-end latency over SGLang by 5.4$\times$ on average and up to 14.9$\times$ while preserving task accuracy. The code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于扩散大语言模型的调度引擎DWISE，通过预测去噪工作量并据此进行调度，显著提升了推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有服务框架采用为自回归模型设计的调度策略（如FCFS和预填充优先），这些策略不适用于dLLM，会因解码成本未知导致队头阻塞，且仅处理提示词的轮次会使大部分批次闲置，从而严重浪费了dLLM的推理速度。
AI.method: 提出DWISE调度引擎，根据以块级单位衡量的剩余工作量调度请求，使预填充和去噪阶段共享同一轮次；并利用轻量级提示预测器结合首轮去噪隐藏状态的细化来预测未知的去噪工作量。
AI.result: 在SGLang框架中实现并在五个模型上评估，DWISE在保持任务准确性的同时，平均将端到端延迟降低了5.4倍，最高达14.9倍。
AI.conclusion: DWISE成功解决了dLLM服务中的调度低效问题，在保证准确性的前提下大幅提升了推理效率，代码将公开。

title: Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: The decoding order of masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can substantially affect generation quality, yet common decoders typically apply the same reveal rule throughout generation. Confidence provides a strong default, but it measures how decisively a position can be predicted now, not how useful revealing that position will be for subsequent decoding. We propose Cord, a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that retains confidence decoding as a stable reference and learns when and how to depart from it through geometric residuals over generation direction, proximity to revealed context, and two-sided infilling. The residuals adapt to both the prompt and the evolving partial response. Rather than sampling a new policy action at every decoding step, Cord samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout, which induces an entire state-dependent reveal trajectory. This yields a contextual-bandit formulation trained directly from sequence-level rewards, without step-level credit assignment or backbone updates. Across three dLLMs and five reasoning, code, and constraint-satisfaction benchmarks, Cord improves average task success from 32.0% under confidence decoding to 48.2%, and further improves over the best per-domain fixed residual. Behavioral audits show that the learned residuals induce substantial, task-dependent changes in reveal locality and two-sided infilling. Cord adds only $0.53$M trainable parameters, requires no additional backbone forward passes, and incurs only 5.39% inference latency overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级提示条件解码策略Cord，通过几何残差动态调整掩码扩散语言模型的揭示顺序，在极少额外开销下显著提升了多领域任务的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型的解码顺序严重影响生成质量，而常用的置信度解码仅衡量当前位置当前的可预测性，并未评估揭示该位置对后续解码的有用程度。
AI.method: 提出Cord策略，保留置信度解码作为参考，通过基于生成方向、上下文接近度及双侧填充的几何残差来动态调整揭示规则。该方法每次rollout仅采样一个低维系数矩阵生成完整揭示轨迹，基于序列级奖励的上下文老虎机进行训练，无需步级信用分配或骨干网络更新。
AI.result: 在三个dLLMs和五个基准测试上，Cord将平均任务成功率从32.0%（置信度解码）提升至48.2%，并优于最佳的固定残差。该方法仅增加0.53M可训练参数和5.39%的推理延迟，且无需额外骨干网络前向传播。
AI.conclusion: Cord以极低的参数和延迟开销，通过自适应的几何残差有效优化了dLLMs的解码顺序，显著提升了推理、代码和约束满足等任务的性能，证明了动态解码策略相较于静态规则的优越性。

title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation
summary: We propose Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni (NLD-Uni), a unified discrete diffusion large language model (DLLM) for visual understanding and generation tasks. Compared with prior unified diffusion models, NLD-Uni introduces two major innovations. First, we propose a unified cross-paradigm on-policy distillation (OPD) framework that successfully transfers the visual understanding ability of autoregressive VLMs and visual generation ability of continuous flow models, to a unified DLLM. Second, NLD-Uni incorporates a novel progressive self-refining diffusion process that gradually corrupts each token across multiple steps during training, as opposed to adopting the conventional masked diffusion formulation that directly corrupts a clean image token to an uninformative mask token. At inference, this design allows NLD-Uni to make intermediate commit to a token, enabling progressive self-refinement for better visual quality. Through extensive experiments, we show that NLD-Uni achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified DLLMs on diverse tasks including visual question-answering, multi-modal reasoning, object grounding, text-to-image generation, and image editing.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个用于视觉理解和生成任务的统一离散扩散大语言模型NLD-Uni。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决在单一模型中同时实现高质量视觉理解与生成的挑战，克服先前统一扩散模型的局限。
AI.method: 提出统一的跨范式在线策略蒸馏（OPD）框架和渐进式自精炼扩散过程，结合自回归VLMs和连续流模型的优势。
AI.result: 在视觉问答、多模态推理、对象定位、文本到图像生成和图像编辑等任务上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: NLD-Uni证明了统一DLLM在视觉理解与生成任务上的有效性，为未来多模态模型的发展提供了新方向。

title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了dSpark框架，通过调度蒸馏学习何时提交token，以加速扩散大语言模型的并行生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型虽然能并行生成多个token，但通常需要多次解码轮次，而高效生成不仅依赖于易预测的token，还依赖于揭示某些token如何帮助预测剩余位置。
AI.method: 构建优先揭示能够使其他位置更容易预测的token的解掩码调度，以更早减少不确定性；然后将这些调度蒸馏到模型中，并使用KL散度正则化器保持生成质量。
AI.result: 在GSM8K任务上，该方法分别在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上实现了10.12倍和5.12倍的加速，同时保持了优越的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: dSpark框架能显著提升扩散大语言模型的生成速度并维持质量，代码已开源。

title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
summary: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过联合调整扩散努力程度和推测解码接受宽松度，探索并扩展了速度-质量帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 传统推测解码是无损的，而扩散LLM可通过降低质量换取速度；本文旨在探索这两个参数联合变化下的完整可实现帕累托前沿。
AI.method: 提出联合变化扩散努力程度和推测解码接受宽松度两个参数，以探索完整的速度-质量帕累托前沿。
AI.result: 实验表明，联合调整扩散努力程度和接受宽松度可以扩展速度-质量帕累托前沿，优于单步扩散草稿方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化扩散努力和接受宽松度，可实现比单步扩散草稿更优的速度-质量权衡，为推测扩散解码提供了新的优化方向。

title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
summary: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出使用连续扩散语言模型替代随机映射，生成更自然的对抗性提示，从而更准确地评估黑盒LLM的风险。
AI.motivation: 现有的连续空间攻击使用未从语言中学习的随机映射，导致生成的提示高度不自然，易被输入防护机制检测，且所得的风险估计缺乏自然提示的支撑。
AI.method: 将连续潜在空间框架直接与学习的语言生成分布（连续扩散语言模型，dLLM）结合，去除人工随机映射，同时保留标准高斯潜在公式及下游采样或优化过程。
AI.result: 在RareTrap和ThinkTrap两种设置下评估，字符级困惑度分别从10^3-10^7降至3-5，以及从20-28降至4.3-5.4。此外，两种映射下的模型风险估计相差一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 使用dLLM取代随机映射能显著降低对抗性提示的困惑度，使其更自然，进而更准确地评估黑盒大模型的安全风险。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了树退出验证（TEV）和退出引导草稿树训练（ExitTrain）两种方法，分别通过更直接的验证降低延迟和通过目标反馈提高接受率。
AI.motivation: 基于草稿分数构建的有限树在树结构投机解码中面临草稿模型与目标模型的基本不匹配问题，本文旨在解决如何通过更好的精确验证提高固定树上的接受率，以及如何利用目标反馈改进树本身。
AI.method: 通过目标流视角识别规范退出定律，提出了一种精确且层并行的树退出验证（TEV）程序；同时利用退出定律识别缺失的目标概率，提供节点级反馈，提出了用于推理时草稿树的退出引导草稿树训练（ExitTrain）。
AI.result: 在对话、代码和数学推理任务上的实验表明，ExitTrain将平均输出块长度提高了13%，TEV将验证阶段延迟降低了15%，相比DDTree实现了14%的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果区分了两个改进机会：一是构建更好的草稿树以获得更高的接受率，二是采用更直接的验证方法以降低延迟。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DominoTree，一种结合路径相关因果校正的无训练树状投机解码方法，显著提升了大语言模型的推理速度。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAFT框架，通过引入目标蒸馏边打分和状态感知预算分配，为扩散语言模型草稿器优化推测解码树构建，实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的DDTree在为扩散语言模型（DLM）构建推测解码草稿树时，仅依赖token概率选择边而忽略了父子兼容性，且采用固定预算无法适应不同解码状态下的最优吞吐量。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 目标蒸馏边打分（TDES），通过从目标模型轨迹中蒸馏父子偏好来选择目标兼容的边；2) 状态感知预算分配（SABA），通过平衡预期草稿增益与验证成本来动态设置每轮的树预算。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13倍至6.36倍的端到端加速，且每轮增加的开销低于0.5毫秒（约占目标模型验证延迟的1.4%）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT成功克服了基于扩散语言模型的推测解码在树构建方面的瓶颈，以极低的额外开销实现了高效的端到端加速。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出CaDDTree，一种成本感知的扩散草稿树方法，通过联合优化树结构和节点预算来最大化推测解码中的令牌吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有块扩散草稿器（如DDTree）在固定节点预算下最大化期望接受长度，但接受长度总是偏好更大的树而忽略了验证成本，缺乏选择预算的原则性基础。
AI.method: 提出CaDDTree（成本感知扩散草稿树），通过联合选择树结构和节点预算直接优化令牌吞吐量。该方法显式建模草稿和验证延迟，将吞吐量目标分解为每轮对预算的一维搜索，并证明了在凸验证成本下吞吐量函数是单峰的，从而实现高效的贪婪停止规则。CaDDTree无需离线预算搜索，可根据当前位置分布和验证成本在每轮中自适应调整预算。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上的八个基准测试（涵盖推理、编码和指令遵循任务）表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上均匹配或超越了使用预言机预算选择的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree为块扩散草稿器中的预算选择提供了一种原则性的成本感知方法，无需离线调整即可有效最大化吞吐量。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种目标感知前缀选择方法TAPS，通过将扩散边缘概率转化为路径条件接受估计，在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭包子树，有效解决了扩散模型并行起草投机解码中的验证瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型用于并行起草的投机解码时，验证阶段成为瓶颈。现有方法基于边缘概率排序节点，忽略了验证是前缀条件的，导致验证不可达的被拒绝前缀的后代，增加了延迟但接受率提升有限。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（目标感知前缀选择方法），将扩散边缘概率转化为路径条件接受估计，并在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭包子树，从而改善接受-成本权衡，而非简单地扩展草案树。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和模型家族上的实验表明，TAPS实现了高达7.9倍的端到端无损加速，相比最先进的DFlash和DDTree分别快1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS通过解决验证瓶颈和节点排序不匹配问题，显著提升了无损解码速度，证明了目标感知的前缀选择在扩散起草投机解码中的有效性。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: DDTree通过从块扩散草案模型的分布构建草案树，扩展了DFlash，提高了推测解码的接受长度和性能。
AI.motivation: 普通DFlash每轮只验证单个草拟轨迹，可能限制其接受长度，因此需要一种方法来增加验证的轨迹数量，从而提高推测解码的效率。
AI.method: DDTree直接从块扩散草案模型的每位置分布构建草案树，在固定节点预算下使用最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的延续，并通过仅祖先注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传递中高效验证。
AI.result: DDTree建立在DFlash基础上获得了性能提升，成为推测解码的领先方法之一。
AI.conclusion: DDTree通过构建草案树扩展了DFlash，在不增加额外计算成本的情况下提高了推测解码的性能，为加速语言模型推理提供了有效解决方案。

title: ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLMs
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample the responses of the open-source multimodal dataset. Second, we are the first to take a decoupled view of multi-modal (MM) understanding and language modeling abilities. We propose a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism to prioritize the MM understanding recovery. We also introduce a vision-sensitive factor $\vecτ$ that effectively identifies the MM-critical layers. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, covering models with 2B-8B parameters, show that ProQuant significantly outperforms existing methods. For example, our W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct improves average accuracy by impressively 6.6% and achieves performance comparable to full precision counterparts with only approximately 1% performance drop. Code is available at https://github.com/yufeixue-ai/ProQuant/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ProQuant，一个针对低比特多模态大语言模型定制的量化感知训练框架，有效解决了低比特量化下的性能下降问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）庞大的计算和内存需求阻碍了其在边缘设备上的部署。虽然后训练量化在中等比特下有效，但在低比特（如W4A8）量化时会导致严重性能下降，特别是对于适合边缘部署的小型模型。
AI.method: ProQuant框架提出自重标记（SRL）方案以对齐微调与预训练数据集分布；首次采用解耦视角看待多模态理解与语言建模能力，并提出渐进式块激活（PBA）机制优先恢复多模态理解能力，同时引入视觉敏感因子识别多模态关键层。
AI.result: 在涵盖2B-8B参数模型的多种基准测试中，ProQuant显著优于现有方法。例如，其W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct平均准确率提升了6.6%，与全精度模型相比仅下降约1%。
AI.conclusion: ProQuant在低比特量化下实现了接近全精度的性能，成功推动了多模态大语言模型在资源受限边缘设备上的实际部署。

title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics-Aware Industrial Anomaly Detection and Reasoning
summary: Industrial Anomaly Detection (IAD) is a long-established problem that aims to detect defects in industrial products during manufacturing for quality control. Most existing studies focus on static visual patterns as the basis for detection. However, in real manufacturing environments, many anomalies are dynamics-based, such as irregular movements that cannot be perceived from static cues alone. We observe that even recent Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based approaches fall short in identifying such dynamic anomalies due to limited temporal modeling capability. To address this, we introduce MUSTARD: MUltimodal SpatioTemporal Anomaly Reasoning and Detection, a framework that equips MLLMs with fine-grained spatiotemporal dynamics awareness for detecting and reasoning about dynamics-based defects. MUSTARD introduces optical-flow-guided keyframe selection and augmented modalities to capture critical motion irregularities through local motion patterns and global dynamic evolution. Its normal pattern-based reasoning pipeline requires only a few normal reference samples as the detection basis, avoiding any model updates. This enables efficient adaptation across various products and provides high decision interpretability. MUSTARD is the first MLLM-based framework for dynamics-based IAD. Experiments demonstrate its superior performance in detecting spatiotemporal anomalies and providing plausible explanations. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的动态工业异常检测框架MUSTARD，通过细粒度的时空动态感知来检测和推理基于动态的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的工业异常检测大多关注静态视觉模式，且当前基于MLLM的方法因缺乏时间建模能力，无法有效识别真实制造环境中基于动态的异常（如不规则运动）。
AI.method: MUSTARD框架引入了光流引导的关键帧选择和增强模态，以通过局部运动模式和全局动态演化捕获关键运动异常；其基于正常模式的推理管道仅需少量正常参考样本，无需更新模型。

AI.conclusion: MUSTARD作为首个基于MLLM的动态IAD框架，实现了跨产品的高效适配和高决策可解释性。

title: CST-Bench: Benchmarking Counterfactual Spatial Transition Reasoning with Causal Transition On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing benchmarks mainly focus on static scene understanding. When objects are moved or swapped, models must infer not only spatial relations but also how interventions change the scene state. To address this problem, we introduce CST-Bench, a benchmark for counterfactual spatial reasoning. CST-Bench contains 7,082 examples covering 6 intervention types and 12 transformation operators, with dense causal annotations including intervention sources, affected relations, expected effects, invariant relations, and metric changes. We benchmark general-purpose MLLMs on CST-Bench and further compare post-training strategies on CST-Bench and standard spatial benchmarks. Results show that methods effective for ordinary spatial reasoning can still fail under counterfactual interventions. We further formulate counterfactual spatial reasoning as causal state-transition modeling and propose CT-OPSD, which uses CST-Bench annotations to guide a teacher model in learning counterfactual state transitions and causal reasoning chains. These chains are then distilled into a student model that reasons only from real observations. Overall, experiment results establish CST-Bench as a challenging benchmark and reusable supervision resource for counterfactual spatial reasoning. CT-OPSD further provides an initial demonstration of how its annotations can support model improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了反事实空间推理基准CST-Bench及因果状态转换建模方法CT-OPSD，用于评估和提升多模态大语言模型在动态干预下的空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型空间推理基准主要关注静态场景，无法评估模型在物体移动或交换等干预下推断场景状态变化的能力。
AI.method: 提出CST-Bench基准（包含7082个样本及密集因果标注）；将反事实空间推理形式化为因果状态转换建模，提出CT-OPSD方法，利用基准标注指导教师模型学习因果推理链并蒸馏给学生模型。

title: PSGAgent: Enhancing MLLMs' Dynamic Visual Perception for Panoptic Scene Graph Generation via Agentic Reasoning
summary: Panoptic Scene Graph generation (PSG) requires holistic yet fine-grained reasoning over complex relations among objects. However, current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) applied to PSG suffer from a perception bottleneck: they function as static observers limited by fixed-resolution views. As a result, models often overlook critical relations involving small or peripheral objects and struggle to differentiate ambiguous predicates in complex scenes. To address these limitations, we propose PSGAgent, an agentic framework that enhances visual perception for PSG through a think-act-observe loop. PSGAgent allows MLLMs to dynamically refine their visual perception using two tools: a Region Zoom-In Tool for local exploration of small or boundary relations and a Visual Highlight Tool for relation-focused segmentation that filters out irrelevant contextual noise. To optimize decision-making, we construct a two-stage training pipeline. First, we create a high-quality, error-aware Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (M-CoT) dataset that provides robust supervision for cold-start learning. Then, we design a novel hierarchical reward mechanism integrated with Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) to enable strategic and adaptive tool usage. Extensive experiments on the PSG benchmark show that PSGAgent achieves SOTA performance, demonstrating strong capability in both holistic and fine-grained scene understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PSGAgent智能体框架，通过动态视觉感知工具和两阶段训练机制，有效解决了多模态大语言模型在全场景图生成任务中的感知瓶颈问题，并达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在全景场景图生成（PSG）中受限于固定分辨率视角，存在静态观察的感知瓶颈，导致模型容易忽略小目标或边缘目标的关系，且难以在复杂场景中区分模糊谓词。
AI.method: 提出PSGAgent智能体框架，在“思考-行动-观察”循环中引入区域放大工具和视觉高亮工具来动态优化视觉感知；采用两阶段训练管道，先利用高质量、错误感知的多模态思维链（M-CoT）数据集进行冷启动学习，再通过结合层次化奖励机制的群体序列策略优化（GSPO）来提升自适应工具使用的决策能力。
AI.result: 在PSG基准上的广泛实验表明，PSGAgent实现了最先进的（SOTA）性能，在全局和细粒度场景理解中均展现出强大的能力。
AI.conclusion: PSGAgent成功突破了MLLMs在PSG任务中的固定分辨率限制，通过策略性的工具使用增强了视觉推理能力，为复杂场景下的细粒度关系理解提供了新的范式。

title: MammoSeek: A Mammography Agent with selective zooming for grounded reports
summary: Radiologists read a screening mammogram by first forming a global impression of the four views and then selectively magnifying suspicious regions before assigning a BI-RADS assessment. MLLMs, in contrast, see the whole image at a fixed, reduced resolution, which makes sub-millimeter calcifications invisible, and they perform close to chance on mammography. Therefore, we present MammoSeek, a mammography agent that reproduces this reading process. After forming an impression of each breast, the agent performs selective zooming: it decides by itself which detector candidates deserve a closer look and inspects only those on full-resolution views. Guided by a BI-RADS assessment skill, it then assigns a category and generates a localized, lexicon-structured report for each breast; its assessment is combined with image-model scores in a decision layer to decide recall. On an internal (EMBED) and an external (VinDr-Mammo) dataset, \ours reaches exam-level AUCs of 0.824 and 0.818, far above other MLLMs, mammography agent and CNN classifiers. Selective zooming also outperforms both no zooming and forced zooming in localization, structured-report F1 and recall decisions at low cost.

AI.tldr: 提出MammoSeek智能体，通过模拟放射科医生选择性放大可疑区域并结合BI-RADS评估技能，显著提升了多模态大语言模型在乳腺X线摄影中的表现。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型以固定低分辨率查看图像，导致无法识别亚毫米级钙化，在乳腺X线摄影上表现接近随机，需要一种能模拟放射科医生阅读过程的方法来解决此问题。
AI.method: 提出MammoSeek乳腺X线摄影智能体，在形成全局印象后进行自主选择性全分辨率放大检查，结合BI-RADS评估技能生成结构化报告，并与图像模型分数在决策层融合决定召回。
AI.result: 在内部和外部数据集上，检查级别AUC分别达到0.824和0.818，远超其他MLLM、智能体和CNN分类器；选择性缩放在局部化、结构化报告F1和召回决策上均优于无缩放和强制缩放。
AI.conclusion: 模拟放射科医生工作流的选择性缩放智能体能有效提升乳腺X线摄影的诊断性能，以低成本实现高精度的召回决策。

title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
summary: Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories (SDCLs) are moving chemical experimentation toward embodied automation, where machines must perceive laboratory scenes, reason about experimental states, and act under physical, procedural, and safety constraints. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly considered as embodied brains for such systems, existing laboratory benchmarks mainly focus on safety, anomaly detection, or general scientific understanding, leaving their execution-oriented embodied capabilities underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BEAKER, a Benchmark for evaluating Embodied Actionability, Knowledge, Experimentation, and Reasoning in SDCLs. BEAKER contains 1,000 expert-curated question-answer samples across 11 image and video task types, covering key judgments required for chemical laboratory execution, including affordance grounding, trajectory planning, equipment, state, and safety recognition, apparatus setup, operation and step reasoning, and temporal procedure reasoning. All questions and annotations are manually created and reviewed by chemistry and embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts, without AI-assisted generation or annotation. We evaluate 28 general-purpose, science-oriented, chemistry-specialized, and embodied MLLMs in an offline, single-turn setting. Results show that current models can follow coarse experimental procedures in videos, but still struggle to ground actions into operable regions and feasible trajectories, to recognize fine-grained laboratory apparatus, states, and safety norms, and to order steps in mid-length procedures. BEAKER thus reveals a clear gap between coarse procedural understanding and the precise, action-grounded perception required for laboratory execution, providing a diagnostic benchmark for future MLLMs in SDCLs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BEAKER基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在自动驾驶化学实验室中的具身执行能力。
AI.motivation: 现有实验室基准主要关注安全性、异常检测或通用科学理解，而MLLMs在化学实验室执行导向的具身能力方面尚未被充分探索，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: BEAKER包含1,000个由化学和具身AI专家手工创建和审核的问答样本，涵盖11种图像和视频任务类型，包括可供性定位、轨迹规划、设备/状态/安全识别、装置搭建、操作与步骤推理及时序过程推理。在离线单轮设置下评估了28个通用、科学导向、化学专用及具身MLLMs。
AI.result: 当前模型能够跟随视频中的粗粒度实验流程，但在将动作定位到可操作区域和可行轨迹、识别细粒度实验装置/状态/安全规范以及中等长度流程的步骤排序方面仍然表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: BEAKER揭示了粗粒度过程理解与实验室执行所需的精确动作感知之间的明显差距，为未来SDCLs中MLLMs的研究提供了诊断性基准。

title: Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers
summary: A central yet under-explored question in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is where to connect---how visual information from a hierarchical vision encoder should be wired into the layer-wise semantics of a large language model. Mainstream MLLMs inject a fixed single-layer visual representation into the LLM and treat all LLM layers as a single consumer, ignoring that different layers demand different visual granularities. Recent multi-layer fusion methods either compress hierarchical features on the encoder side or rely on predefined sparse or hierarchical layer-to-layer connections, and therefore stop short of modeling adaptive cross-layer interactions between the ViT and LLM hierarchies. We address this gap with DGP (Dynamic Gated Pathways), a routing mechanism that establishes all-to-all connections between every ViT layer and every LLM layer, with each LLM layer dynamically gating its preference over visual layers conditioned on its own semantic state. Built on top of LLaVA-1.5-7B and 13B, DGP delivers consistent gains over the LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline (e.g., +4.2 on SQA$^{I}$, +3.3 on MM-Vet, +3.1 on VizWiz and LLaVA$^{W}$) and surpasses prior multi-layer visual fusion methods on most benchmarks. Layer-wise routing analyses further show that different LLM layers do select different visual granularities on demand, supporting both the effectiveness and interpretability of the proposed dynamic gated pathways. The code is available: https://github.com/YingyingYan1/DGP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态门控路径（DGP），通过在视觉编码器和大语言模型各层间建立全连接路由机制，实现自适应的跨层视觉信息融合。
AI.motivation: 主流多模态大语言模型向LLM注入固定的单层视觉特征，忽略了不同LLM层对视觉粒度的不同需求；现有多层融合方法依赖预定义连接或压缩特征，无法自适应建模ViT与LLM层级间的交互。
AI.method: 提出动态门控路径（DGP），在ViT各层与LLM各层之间建立全连接，使每个LLM层能根据自身当前语义状态动态门控并选择偏好的视觉层。
AI.result: 基于LLaVA-1.5构建的DGP在多个基准上取得显著提升（如SQA^I +4.2, MM-Vet +3.3等），超越既有多层视觉融合方法；层级分析证实不同LLM层确实会按需选择不同视觉粒度。
AI.conclusion: DGP通过动态可解释的门控路径有效提升了多模态大模型中视觉与语言特征的跨层交互能力，验证了自适应视觉特征选择的优越性。

title: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning for Remote Sensing in Urban Management
summary: Fine-grained visual reasoning is essential for remote sensing in urban management, yet remains underexplored in the evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UMBench, a fine-grained urban remote sensing benchmark built from unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) images for multiple urban management tasks such as traffic monitoring, urban construction, environmental quality, and disaster warning. Evaluations on UMBench reveal that current MLLMs often rely on scene-level priors and overlook fine-grained visual evidence. To address this issue, we further propose a novel evidence-first chain-of-thought method that directs models to inspect fine-grained visual evidence in a training-free manner. Experiments show that our method can improve the performance of both open-source and commercial MLLMs on UMBench.
comment: Accepted by IEEE AP-GARSS 2026; 4 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables

AI.tldr: 本文提出了用于城市管理的细粒度遥感基准UMBench，并设计了一种无需训练的证据优先思维链方法来改进多模态大语言模型的细粒度视觉推理。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉推理在城市管理遥感中至关重要，但目前针对多模态大语言模型在此方面的评估仍不充分；现有模型往往依赖场景级先验而忽略细粒度的视觉证据。
AI.method: 构建了基于无人机图像的城市遥感基准UMBench，并提出一种证据优先的思维链方法，在无需训练的情况下引导模型检查细粒度视觉证据。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法有效提升了开源和商用多模态大语言模型在UMBench上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大语言模型在细粒度视觉证据识别上存在局限，而所提的无训练方法能有效弥补这一不足，提升模型在城市场景中的视觉推理能力。

title: DreamRealm: Exploring and Materializing Hallucination Worlds for Trustworthy Vision-Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain prone to visual hallucinations when correct responses depend on subtle visual details. One line of post-training methods constructs visual contrasts through image retrieval, generation, or editing to improve fine-grained perception. However, these contrasts are not built around the model's own hallucinations, making it difficult to ensure that supervision targets its actual perceptual confusions. Another line suppresses hallucinated outputs through response correction or preference learning under fixed image conditions, but leaves the design of supervision signals on the image-input side underexplored. Inspired by how humans correct misconceptions, we introduce DreamRealm, a post-training framework that explores diverse latent hallucinated responses, minimally edits original images to make them valid, and trains the model to assign each response to its supporting image. Our data construction pipeline, RealmForgePipe, mines observed and latent hallucinations from a target model and materializes them through image editing. Using hallucinations mined from Qwen3.5-9B, we construct the Realized Hallucination Dataset (RealmSet). Our training objective, RealmMatch, constructs a likelihood score matrix across image--response combinations and combines supervised learning with bidirectional contrastive losses to reinforce correct matches and suppress mismatches. Compared with the original Qwen3.5-9B model, DreamRealm improves performance across six visual perception and hallucination benchmarks, including gains of 7.26 percentage points in HallusionBench accuracy and 11.34 percentage points in MMVP pair accuracy. Together with ablation studies on data construction and training methods, these results demonstrate that hallucination assignment is a promising paradigm for improving visual perception and mitigating hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 提出DreamRealm后训练框架，通过挖掘模型潜在幻觉并微调图像使其成立，训练模型将幻觉响应与支持图像正确匹配，从而缓解多模态大语言模型的视觉幻觉。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在依赖细微视觉细节时易产生视觉幻觉；现有后训练方法构建的视觉对比未围绕模型自身的幻觉，或在固定图像下抑制幻觉而忽略了图像输入侧的监督信号设计。
AI.method: 提出DreamRealm后训练框架及数据构建管道RealmForgePipe，挖掘目标模型观察到和潜在的幻觉，并通过最小化图像编辑将其实体化。训练目标RealmMatch构建图像-响应组合的似然性评分矩阵，结合监督学习和双向对比损失来强化正确匹配并抑制错误匹配。
AI.result: 与原始Qwen3.5-9B模型相比，DreamRealm在六个视觉感知和幻觉基准测试上均取得性能提升，其中HallusionBench准确率提升7.26个百分点，MMVP对准确率提升11.34个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉分配（即将幻觉响应与编辑后的支持图像相匹配）是改善视觉感知和减轻多模态大语言模型幻觉的一种极具前景的范式。

title: Entropogram-guided Visual Realignment Decoding: Capturing the Rhythm of Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress on cross-modal reasoning tasks, yet they continue to suffer from hallucinations in long-chain reasoning processes. In this work, we revisit hallucination in MLLMs from the perspective of reasoning generation dynamics. We argue that entropy is not merely a static measure of uncertainty but a structured signal that reflects how modality information is integrated throughout decoding. Through systematic analysis, we identify two characteristic entropy patterns associated with hallucination behaviors: (1) a generally high-confidence regime corresponds to premature convergence to inappropriate multimodal interactions; and (2) local abrupt entropy transitions are associated with reasoning instability and hallucination onset. Building on these observations, we propose an entropy-aware self-introspective framework for MLLM reasoning. Our method continuously tracks entropy dynamics during decoding and performs targeted visual re-alignment when suspicious hallucination states are detected, encouraging the model to re-examine salient visual evidence at critical reasoning stages. Extensive experiments across six multimodal reasoning benchmarks spanning nine distinct evaluation settings demonstrate that our approach delivers robust improvements in reasoning accuracy and hallucination robustness, while providing new insights into the generation dynamics underlying MLLM failures. The code is available at: https://github.com/jden4524/SelfRetrospectiveDecoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于熵感知的自省框架，通过追踪解码过程中的熵动态并执行视觉重新对齐，以缓解多模态大语言模型在长链推理中的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在长链推理过程中易产生幻觉。本文旨在从推理生成动态（即熵的变化）的角度重新审视并解决这一幻觉问题，因为熵不仅是静态不确定性指标，更是反映模态信息整合过程的结构化信号。
AI.method: 提出一个熵感知自省框架。该方法持续追踪解码期间的熵动态，识别出与幻觉相关的两种特征模式（高置信度导致的过早收敛，以及局部突发的熵转变导致的推理不稳定）。一旦检测到可疑的幻觉状态，便进行针对性的视觉重新对齐，促使模型在关键推理阶段重新审视显著视觉证据。
AI.result: 在跨九种不同评估设置的六个多模态推理基准上的广泛实验表明，该方法在推理准确性和幻觉鲁棒性方面均取得了稳健的提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅有效提升了模型的推理准确性和抗幻觉能力，还为理解多模态大语言模型失败的底层生成动态提供了新视角与新见解。
